candidates.title: 42 of 69 production-region `#[allow(...)]` openers in the 5d manifest carry no rationale, refuting the premise the census clearing rests on

evidence.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,subprocess
files=subprocess.run(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only','077dbe2c','crates/cobre-sddp/src/'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()
# 5d manifest = the 41 non-test files of error.rs, lib.rs, hull/, lead_time/, production/, simulation/
rat=re.compile(r'rationale|safety:|precision|deliberate|by design|reserved',re.I)
# for each file: keep only the region before the first top-level #[cfg(test)];
# an opener is 'rationale' if the contiguous comment/attr block above it matches rat,
# 'other-comment' if that block or the same line carries any //, else 'bare'.
EOF

files 41 openers 69 rationale 15 other-comment 12 bare 42
bare-by-file [('simulation/extraction.rs', 11), ('simulation/state.rs', 6), ('simulation/aggregation.rs', 5), ('production/fpha_fitting/geometry.rs', 4), ('production/fpha_fitting/grid.rs', 4), ('production/fpha_fitting/secant.rs', 4), ('simulation/pipeline.rs', 3), ('simulation/enumerated.rs', 2), ('production/fpha_fitting/rng.rs', 1), ('production/hydro_models/export.rs', 1), ('production/hydro_models/production.rs', 1)]
bare-lints [('cast_possible_truncation', 30), ('cast_sign_loss', 6), ('cast_precision_loss', 6)]

    #[allow(clippy::cast_sign_loss)]
    let requested_volume_points = config.volume_discretization_points.unwrap_or(5) as usize;

$ git show 077dbe2c:crates/cobre-io/src/extensions/production_models.rs | sed -n '171p'
    pub volume_discretization_points: Option<i32>,

$ git show 077dbe2c:docs/design/reserved-seams-and-deferred-debt.md | sed -n '1278,1284p'
**Load-bearing.** Numeric-cast lints (`cast_possible_truncation`,
`cast_precision_loss`, `cast_sign_loss`, `cast_possible_wrap`) and
refactor-decision lints (`too_many_arguments`, `too_many_lines`,
`type_complexity`, `struct_field_names`, `implicit_hasher`,
`needless_pass_by_value`, and similar) on production code, **each carrying a
`// Rationale:` comment naming the non-obvious choice the lint would otherwise
flag** — the majority of the census.
evidence.reading: The mirror's census clearing rests on a stated premise: every numeric-cast allow on production code carries a `// Rationale:` naming the non-obvious choice. Over the 5d manifest that premise does not hold for 42 of 69 production-region openers, which carry no comment of any kind. All 42 are numeric-cast lints (cast_possible_truncation 30, cast_sign_loss 6, cast_precision_loss 6) spread over 11 files. This is not the settled "this allow exists" claim the do-not-touch entry clears, and it is disjoint from OD-009: zero of the 42 are `dead_code`, and OD-009's three anchors live under training/. The geometry.rs cluster shows why the missing clause is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: the four casts are sound only because `volume_discretization_points` and its three siblings are validated non-negative, and that fact lives in a different crate (cobre-io production_models.rs, typed `Option<i32>`), so a reader of geometry.rs alone cannot reconstruct it. Anchors name six enclosing declared fns; `enumerated_sim_stage_worker` also encloses two bare openers but is deliberately not anchored because PD-001 names that symbol and is refuted.

candidates.fixShape: Sharpen, do not sweep. For each of the 42 bare openers either narrow the attribute to the expression it guards or add the single clause that records the fact living outside the file, which for the fpha_fitting cluster is the non-negativity validated on the cobre-io config fields. Never delete an allow that CI's zero-warning bar still needs. Under the comment-discipline Deletion Test the clause qualifies precisely because the justifying fact is cross-crate. The work is comment-and-attribute-only and must be byte-neutral: assert the parity goldens in tests/parity.rs through tests/common/parity_hash.rs, the rank-invariance harness in tests/common/permute.rs, and mpiexec -n 1 versus -n 2 reproduction, and move no golden. Blast radius is 11 files under production/fpha_fitting/, production/hydro_models/ and simulation/, with no signature or control-flow change. Touches no pinned contract in .claude/rules/sddp.md, so no section citation applies.

candidates.title: Five `pub(crate)` items in production/ and simulation/ have zero consumers outside their defining file and nothing forces the wider visibility

evidence.command: for s in QuarticSegment TailraceSegments TailraceFamily DEFAULT_REFERENCE_VOLUME_FRACTION SimWorkerParams; do echo "== $s"; git grep -n -w "$s" 077dbe2c -- 'crates/**/*.rs' | sed 's/^077dbe2c://'; done; git show 077dbe2c:crates/cobre-sddp/src/production/fpha_fitting/mod.rs | sed -n '66p'
evidence.output:
== QuarticSegment
crates/cobre-sddp/src/production/fpha_fitting/tailrace.rs (all 6 hits: the pub(crate) struct, its impl, and Vec<QuarticSegment> inside this file)
== TailraceSegments
crates/cobre-sddp/src/production/fpha_fitting/tailrace.rs (all 5 hits inside this file)
== TailraceFamily
crates/cobre-sddp/src/production/fpha_fitting/tailrace.rs (all 7 hits inside this file; TailraceFamilies is a distinct word and is exported)
== DEFAULT_REFERENCE_VOLUME_FRACTION
crates/cobre-sddp/src/production/hydro_models/production.rs (2 hits: the pub(crate) const and its one use in resolve_reference_volume_hm3)
== SimWorkerParams
crates/cobre-sddp/src/simulation/state.rs (3 hits: the pub(crate) struct, its construction, and the &SimWorkerParams<'_> parameter of the private fn run_worker_scenarios)

$ git show 077dbe2c:crates/cobre-sddp/src/production/fpha_fitting/mod.rs | sed -n '66p'
pub(crate) use tailrace::{TailraceFamilies, build_tailrace_families_map};

$ git show 077dbe2c:crates/cobre-sddp/src/production/hydro_models/production.rs | sed -n '655,660p'
/// The sole owner of this literal.
pub(crate) const DEFAULT_REFERENCE_VOLUME_FRACTION: f64 = 0.65;
evidence.reading: Five items are declared `pub(crate)` and have zero mentions outside their defining file, so the wider visibility publishes a crate-wide surface no crate-wide consumer wants. The counter-signal that would justify it is absent in each case: Rust's private_interfaces lint forces `pub(crate)` only when a type appears in a wider-visibility signature, and here `TailraceSegments.segments`, `TailraceFamilies.families` and every field of `SimWorkerParams` are private while `run_worker_scenarios` is a private fn, so nothing forces it. None carries a reserved-seam rationale or `#[allow(dead_code)]`, so none is in the mirror's reserved class. The intended crate surface is stated explicitly at fpha_fitting/mod.rs line 66, which re-exports only TailraceFamilies and build_tailrace_families_map. The const contradicts itself: its own doc calls it the sole owner of the literal while its visibility offers it to the whole crate, and it never appears in a signature.

candidates.fixShape: Narrow each of the five to the visibility its single defining file actually needs, which is private for QuarticSegment, TailraceSegments, TailraceFamily, DEFAULT_REFERENCE_VOLUME_FRACTION and SimWorkerParams, keeping TailraceFamilies and build_tailrace_families_map at pub(crate) because mod.rs re-exports them. Compilation is the verifier: if private_interfaces fires on any of the five, that item is structurally forced and stays pub(crate) with the reason recorded. A visibility narrowing emits no code, but still assert byte-neutrality through the parity goldens in tests/parity.rs via tests/common/parity_hash.rs, the rank-invariance harness in tests/common/permute.rs, and mpiexec -n 1 versus -n 2, and move no golden. Blast radius is three files. No pinned contract in .claude/rules/sddp.md is touched.

candidates.title: `SimulationInputs::new` is a ten-parameter pass-through constructor whose only production caller already carries the suppression it duplicates

evidence.command: git show 077dbe2c:crates/cobre-sddp/src/simulation/state.rs | sed -n '52,118p'; git show 077dbe2c:crates/cobre-sddp/src/simulation/pipeline.rs | sed -n '1040,1085p'; git grep -n -w 'SimulationInputs' 077dbe2c -- 'crates/**/*.rs'
evidence.reading: `SimulationInputs::new` takes ten positional parameters and forwards all ten unchanged into a struct literal, deciding nothing: no defaulting, no validation, no derived field. Every one of the ten fields is `pub`, so the struct literal is available to every caller, and the crate's own sibling tests already use it twice at simulation/pipeline/tests.rs lines 54 and 92 rather than calling `new`. There is exactly one production call site, inside `simulate`, which itself already carries the identical suppression. The constructor therefore exists only to require a second copy of `#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]` and a near-duplicate rationale comment. The written rationale does not answer this finding: it defends against splitting the parameter list, whereas the alternative here is the struct literal the tests already use, which needs no parameter list at all. This is both named 5d shapes at once, a wrapper that forwards without deciding and a struct whose only inherent method is a constructor.

candidates.fixShape: Delete `SimulationInputs::new` and have `simulate` build the value with the struct literal the sibling tests at simulation/pipeline/tests.rs already use, which removes the state.rs suppression and its duplicated rationale. The suppression on `simulate` itself stays, because its own ten parameters are the public signature and are not in scope here. No field visibility changes, since all ten fields are already pub. The change is call-shape only and must be byte-neutral: assert the parity goldens in tests/parity.rs through tests/common/parity_hash.rs, the rank-invariance harness in tests/common/permute.rs, and mpiexec -n 1 versus -n 2 reproduction, and move no golden. Blast radius is two files plus the two sibling test sites that already compile against the literal form. Touches no pinned contract in .claude/rules/sddp.md.
